faqs.q: What is the entry and age policy?
faqs.a: Strictly 21+ only. Physical government-issued photo ID is required at the door. Digital copies and screenshots will not be accepted.

faqs.q: When will the exact venue address be revealed?
faqs.a: The secret warehouse location pin will be sent via SMS and email to confirmed ticket holders 12 hours prior to doors opening.
Tickets are strictly non-refundable. Transfers can only be requested through the official ticketing partner up to 48 hours before the event.

faqs.q: Is there a dancefloor or dress code etiquette?
faqs.a: SHUNYA spaces are dancefloor-first, dark, and comfortable. Strictly no flash photography or invasive phone recording on the main floor.
Please reach out to hello@shunya.example at least 3 days in advance and our team will arrange dedicated assistance, step-free access, and safe seating.

events.shortDescription: Open-air session designed for scale without losing intimacy. Daylight into dusk with an outdoor acoustic arc.
events.description: Open-air session designed for scale without losing intimacy. One stage, one continuous arc, and an outdoor site chosen for acoustic landscape dynamics. From golden hour daylight into the midnight void.

faqs.q: What time do doors open for the sunset session?
faqs.a: Doors open at 16:00. We encourage arriving early to experience the ambient opening set as the sun sets over the landscape.

faqs.q: Are food and beverages available on site?
faqs.a: Yes, curated food stations and a cocktail bar programme will operate throughout the event. Drinking water is free and available everywhere.

faqs.q: Is parking available at the venue?
faqs.a: Designated valet and self-parking areas are available on site. However, we strongly recommend using rideshares or shuttle buses.

about.storyHeading: An empty room is where we start.
about.storyBody: From Shoonya, Everything Begins. That line is the entire philosophy. Shoonya — the void, the zero, the silent floor before the doors open — is where every SHUNYA experience originates. We are an independent event and electronic music experiences brand crafting private celebrations and large-scale electronic music gatherings. We don't just book artists; we build complete sonic and visual rooms.

principles.title: Design the room, not the flyer
principles.body: We start with sightlines, sound pressure, and how human bodies will naturally move. The artwork documents what happened; the room is what people carry forever.

principles.title: One arc, start to finish
principles.body: Every SHUNYA night is programmed as a singular, unified narrative. Opening sets, peaks, and final records are developed in unison with artists.

principles.title: Underground by standard, not by costume
principles.body: Underground means honest sound reproduction, thoughtful lineups, and a safe, respectful crowd. It is an engineering and ethical standard, not a trend.

principles.title: Private means private
principles.body: Private celebrations are never published, tagged, or publicized without explicit written consent. Strict discretion is paramount.
